name: ProjectKickoffReadinessHub
tagline: Never start an engagement unready: kickoff gates, readiness % and a recorded go / no-go.
description: A complete kickoff readiness app for consulting, accounting and legal firms. Track contract, finance, team, access, plan and client readiness items per engagement with owners, due dates, evidence and blockers; see a portfolio heatmap and at-risk kickoffs; record Go, Conditional go, No-go or Defer with an audit trail. Canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Weighted readiness per gate and project
Hard gates that can never be waived
Go / conditional go / no-go / defer decisions with thresholds
At-risk and critical kickoffs inside a configurable window
New project from a configurable template
Bulk status, owner and due-date actions with undo
Drag and drop and keyboard board
Phone layout with bottom view bar
Power Fx outputs and six events
